input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and make it the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.2 requires us to pay HDI an uncapped stipulated amount (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000) whenever we terminate, which can far exceed our fees. Our position is no liquidated damages payable by us; as a fallback we accept an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, and we have added that cap and confirmed it is the only liquidated amount or penalty we owe.

ops.text: The Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, and shall be the only liquidated amount, liquidated damages or penalty payable by the Company under this Agreement.
